{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    tokens = case['tokens']
    calls = case['calls']
    # Sort calls by end (end exclusive)
    sorted_calls = sorted(calls, key=lambda c: c['end'])
    n = len(sorted_calls)
    # Precompute last non-overlapping index
    last_non_overlap = [-1] * n
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i-1, -1, -1):
            if sorted_calls[j]['end'] <= sorted_calls[i]['start']:
                last_non_overlap[i] = j
                break
    # DP: max score up to i
    dp = [0] * n
    choices = [False] * n
    for i in range(n):
        score_i = sorted_calls[i]['score']
        # include i
        include = score_i + (dp[last_non_overlap[i]] if last_non_overlap[i] >= 0 else 0)
        # exclude i
        exclude = dp[i-1] if i>0 else 0
        if include > exclude:
            dp[i] = include
            choices[i] = True
        else:
            dp[i] = exclude
            choices[i] = False
    # Backtrack
    selected = []
    i = n-1
    while i >= 0:
        if choices[i]:
            selected.append(sorted_calls[i])
            i = last_non_overlap[i]
        else:
            i -= 1
    selected.reverse()
    # Build resulting tokens
    result_tokens = []
    current_idx = 0
    for call in selected:
        start = call['start']
        end = call['end']
        # Add tokens before this call
        while current_idx < start:
            result_tokens.append(tokens[current_idx])
            current_idx += 1
        # Replace interval with replacement tokens
        result_tokens.extend(call['replacement_tokens'])
        current_idx = end
    # Add remaining tokens after last call
    while current_idx < len(tokens):
        result_tokens.append(tokens[current_idx])
        current_idx += 1
    # Collect selected call ids in original order? Use the order from backtrack (already sorted by start)
    selected_call_ids = [c['call_id'] for c in selected]
    return {
        'selected_call_ids': selected_call_ids,
        'tokens': result_tokens
    }"
}
